title: Realistic Content
content: Replace all placeholder content with realistic, contextual mock data. User names: realistic full names with diverse backgrounds. Company data: actual-sounding company names, addresses, phone numbers. Product descriptions: detailed, benefit-focused copy matching industry. Dates: realistic relative dates ("2 hours ago", "Dec 15, 2024"). Prices: appropriate for the product/service type. Images: use placeholder services with relevant categories (picsum.photos, unsplash). Statistics: believable numbers with proper formatting. Comments/reviews: varied lengths and sentiments. Email addresses: realistic format (not test@test.com). Avoid Lorem Ipsum entirely. Match content tone to the app purpose (professional, casual, technical).

variants.advanced: Replace all placeholder content with realistic, contextual mock data that makes the app feel production-ready. User data: realistic full names with diverse cultural backgrounds (Sarah Chen, Marcus Johnson, Priya Patel), profile images from randomuser.me or UI Faces, varied roles and departments. Company data: actual-sounding company names (Horizon Technologies, Stellar Analytics), real address formats, formatted phone numbers ((555) 123-4567). Product content: detailed benefit-focused descriptions matching industry tone, realistic specs and features, varied pricing ($29.99, $149/month). Temporal data: relative dates ("2 hours ago", "Yesterday", "Dec 15, 2024"), realistic timestamps spanning recent days/weeks. Financial data: believable statistics with proper formatting ($1.2M, 45.6%, 12,847 users), varied enough to seem real. Images: use Unsplash (source.unsplash.com/400x300/?office) or Pexels for contextual images, picsum.photos for generic placeholders. Reviews/comments: varied lengths (one-liners to paragraphs), mix of sentiments (4-5 stars, some 3 stars), realistic usernames and dates. Email formats: firstname.lastname@company.com, not test@test.com. Avoid entirely: Lorem Ipsum, "Test User", placeholder@example.com, obviously fake data. Content tone: match app purpose (professional for B2B, casual for consumer, technical for dev tools). Consistency: same person's name throughout their data, logical relationships between data points. Volume: 5-10 items minimum for lists to show realistic usage.
